questions.content: A long insulated copper wire is closely wound as a spiral of N turns. The spiral has inner radius a and outer radius b. The spiral lies in the xy-plane and a steady current I flows through the wire. The z-component of the magnetic field at the centre of the spiral is

questions.explanation:
Magnetic field at the centre of a circular loop of radius r and carrying a current . The direction of the field is along z-direction if the current is anticlockwise.

Consider a small element of width dr. The current through the element is
